text: つかまえた　ポケモンは　２０しゅるい　より　おおい　かな？

structure.jp: つかまえた　ポケモンは
２０しゅるい　より　おおい

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかまえた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing is meant. つかまえた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you caught'.

patterns.name: 〜より
patterns.span: ２０しゅるい　より　おおい
patterns.explanation: より comes after the thing you compare against, like 'than'. ２０しゅるい　より　おおい = 'more than 20 kinds'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end turns the sentence into a gentle 'I wonder'. おおい　かな = 'is it more, I wonder'.
